name: Ask for a live season to close
description: Admin only. Writes an INTENT -- close_requested_at on the season the slug names, if it is the live one -- which the withdraw clock consumes within the minute: it rejects the versions still waiting, cancels the queue, leaves in-flight matches to finish and count, and sets closed_at. An intent rather than the close itself keeps one copy of the close, in the package whose check-sql.sh checks it. 202 with the season as it stands; 409 when that season is not live or the request was already made. The slug is in the path so a close names the season it ends: an admin reading last week's tab cannot close this week's by accident.

with.name: Admins only
with.description: The role is read off the live session rather than off a claim in the cookie, so revoking a session or demoting a user takes effect on the next request.

input.query: UPDATE seasons s SET close_requested_at = now() FROM games g WHERE g.id = s.game_id AND g.slug = ($1)::text AND s.slug = ($2)::text AND s.closed_at IS NULL AND s.close_requested_at IS NULL

body.detail: Only the live season can be asked to close, and only once.

input.query: SELECT season_json(s) AS body FROM games g, current_season(g.id, ($2)::text) s WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text
